notes.title: Kingdom of Dinza patch 1.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Knights!

The Kingdom of Dinza is celebrating its latest major patch - patch 1.2 which overhauls many aspects of the game for a far smoother gameplay experience. Additionally multiple bugs have been fixed and numerous quality of life improvements have been made.

We also offer a limited time discount for the game to make this celebration even more festive!

notes.title: Big news coming to the Kingdom of Dinza!
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

In the coming days Kingdom of Dinza will be updated with a major patch as well as a holiday sale with a significant discount!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Kingdom of Dinza celebrates first month with update
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Kingdom of Dinza celebrates today a first full month of release with game update 1.13!

This update focuses on overhauling elements of the inventory system for easier player gaming.

We would like to thank everyone who joined us in this grand adventure so far and to those who are joining now - here's to all of you and to many more months of Kingdom of Dinza yet to come!

notes.title: Some New Minor Updates for Kingdom of Dinza
notes.content:
Hello brave adventurers!

In this update we will cover the latest quality of life changes to the game:

[list]
[*] Staying for a few seconds near the campfire will heal your knight
[*] Eliminated the loading screen entirely for death's in the world
[*] Eliminated the loading screen entirely when using the Compass item to teleport back to camp
[*] Additional minor bug fixes and stability issues were also addressed
[/list] 

That's it for now!
Keep adventuring and stay safe!

notes.title: Lady Knight has Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Patch 1.1 is now live and with arrives Lady Knight!

You can now play the game as the aforementioned lady, including all customization options.

Next up - in the coming weeks we will introduce world bosses! After that - pets! 
Which kind of pet would you like to see? Let us know on the community page.

Have fun!

notes.title: What's next for Kingdom of Dinza?
notes.content:
Hello brave adventurers!
How is your journey through the Kingdom of Dinza been treating you?
Over the next few weeks there will be some updates to the game, some minor some large, and we wanted to give you guys and gals a glimpse of what’s to come:
[list]
[*] Lady Knight joins the adventure! Players will be able to play as Lady Knight with a full set of customization options!
[*] World bosses! 
[*] Player pets!
[/list]
These and more will be coming soon so keep playing and we’ll see you in the Kingdom!

notes.title: Kingdome of Dinza Released!
notes.content:
Welcome brave knights!

Kingdom of Dinza is available now!

Explore our procedurally generated world, fight monsters, craft or get new gear and conquer the wilds of the Kingdome of Dinza!

New updates will be coming soon as well, more on that soon.

Enjoy a great new adventure!

notes.title: Kingdom of Dinza to Release December 23rd
notes.content:
Hello to all Knights eager for adventure!

Kingdom of Dinza will release on Steam tomorrow - December 23rd!

Sharpen your swords and your wits as you prepare to take your first steps into a mysterious new world!
